name: OSSGadget (.NET 8 + 6)
postCreateCommand: (curl -sSL https://dot.net/v1/dotnet-install.sh | sudo bash -s -- --channel 6.0 --runtime dotnet --install-dir "$(dirname "$(readlink -f "$(which dotnet)")")" || echo 'Skipping .NET 6 runtime install') && cd "${containerWorkspaceFolder}/src" && dotnet restore OSSGadget.sln
